invariants.rationale: Method collects and returns a list; always non-null.
Method operates on data and calls stream(); it must be non-null.
mapToPairFunc is passed to a wrapper and used in a map, so it must be non-null.
reduceFunc is wrapped and used in a reduce operation, so it must be non-null.
Parallelism is generally expected to be positive for a parallel stream, though not enforced by code.
